question: What ritual structure is completed by worshipping the Yoginī in this manner?
premises: The Yoginī is to be worshipped.
The procedure is summarized as thus.
The worship constitutes the nine-enclosure worship.
inference: Worshipping the Yoginī in this way completes the worship of the nine enclosures.
plain_english: One should worship the Yoginī; thus is the worship of the nine enclosures completed.
